scope_note: All game recordings are manual Plato self-play demonstrations, not autonomous Chernika gameplay.
media_policy: Raw MP4s are not committed to this public repository; SHA-256 and derived annotations are stored instead.
split_policy: Grouped by recording to prevent frame leakage.

recordings.notes: 7 ordinary shots reported; 8 slider measurements; 4 rolling trajectories; 5 collisions; 3 cushion impacts. Combo badge ~15.2s, bank badge ~22.9s, right-spin selector ~20.8s. Provisional physics estimates: friction .0079, ball restitution .946, cushion restitution .815, cue speed 1.010–2.667m/s. Target progression 1→2→3→6→8→Pocket 9; won.

Target sequence 1→2→3. 1-ball pocketed ~16.5s; 2-ball ~25.5s; recording ends with target 3 active. Foul notices at 0s and ~9s. Three prior power readings .59/.97/.55 remain recording-level until frame-to-shot linkage is re-audited.

Four outcomes: 3→right-middle, 6→top-right, 8→bottom-right, 9→top-right. Power .3144/.4703/.6337/.9951; legacy valid interval .264851–.623762, so samples 3–4 are out of range. First-contact verification incomplete; use outcome/target labels only.

Long-match target progression 1→2→3→8→Pocket 9. Break pocketed two; 6-ball pocketed ~53s while target 1; user scratch ~77s, opponent JW7 scratch ~81s; 2-ball ~94s, 7-ball ~104s while target 3, 3-ball ~112s, 8-ball ~120s; game won ~128s. Exact target-1 clear time and some first contacts remain uncertain.

Four reviewed shots: 1 bank→top-right, 2 direct→top-left, 3 direct→bottom-left with right spin, 5→9 combination→top-right. UI powers 97.8%, 29.5%, 97.8%, 73.8%; user confirmed 97.8% means maximum effective power (1.0) and shot 3 used right spin. Break pocketed two; game won.
